Title: Add -SkipDotNet/-SkipOllama/-SkipModels parameters to deploy scripts
Description: installer/SplitBrainAI.iss [Run] section calls setup-node-a.ps1 and setup-node-b.ps1 with -SkipDotNet -SkipOllama -SkipModels flags that do not exist in either script. PowerShell throws 'A parameter cannot be found' on every service install step, silently breaking service registration. Fix: add [switch]$SkipDotNet, [switch]$SkipOllama, [switch]$SkipModels to both deploy scripts and wrap corresponding sections.
